craft_notes: Sthāyin: svādhyāya-vīra of study-and-making — hermetic couplets, hyphen-pressure; music in pack + terminal words; FIRST VERSE of the work sets the house voice (owner verdict required). Study-vow: anuccāryām kept (unspeakable-not-unspoken per UNC); rest-filled end-weight. Rejected: (a) unspoken → killed by UNC. (b) unpacking beginning-end-entered → killed: pack is the study. Read aloud: REST-filled WITH-pow-er GONE-with-IN … I-STUD-y-SPEECH: THE-lord's-HEART.

lines: Rest-filled with power gone within, beginning to end — unspeakable —
I study speech: the Lord's heart.
l4.sanskrit_cite: ādyantāntargatānantaśaktiviśrāntinirbharām anuccāryām | ahaṃ vācam adhīye hṛdayaṃ vibhoḥ
